title: Portfolio projects
description: Projects shown in the Projects section of amanmittal.xyz.

projects.description: Newest first. Featured projects are pulled to the top automatically.

name.description: Project title, shown as the card heading.

tagline.description: Optional one-liner shown under the title, e.g. "Your Supply Chain, With a Brain."

description.description: Short paragraph describing the project. Two to three sentences reads best on the card.

image.description: Path to a cover image inside the public folder, e.g. "/images/projects/my-project.png". Landscape (16:9) works best.

demo.description: Optional live deployment URL. Leave out or use an empty string if there isn't one.

tags.description: Optional technology labels shown as chips on the card.

featured.description: Optional. Featured projects are listed before the rest.
